news.title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
news.summary: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
news.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.
news.articleText: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published One of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry's most important figures has been accused of having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang admitted, external to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US tech giant Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, has opened an independent investigation into the affair. It said it does not believe US national security had been compromised - and added that Jensen Huang was committed to continuing to lead the company. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. Who is Alice Huang and what do we know about the affair? US officials believed that Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. Her current whereabouts are unknown. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. The firm had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia maintains was investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singapore government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. She did not respond to the paper's request for comment. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. "We trust that if we were the target of a genuine threat, the US government would have notified us," an Nvidia spokesperson told the BBC. China has rejected the spying allegations. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters: "The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." The New York Times reported in late October that US President Donald Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he wished he had "acted on the intelligence", Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's [Jensen Huang] an honourable guy." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Jensen Huang. Last spring, the secretary of state reportedly oversaw the drafting of a memo that warned the Trump administration about Jensen Huang's relationship with the Chinese businesswoman. - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published23 hours ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published8 hours ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among American lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of US companies like Nvidia, working with producers like the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Jensen Huang once saying that Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. Huang has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. Sunday's revelations may explain why Jensen Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. Jensen Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Jensen Huang. Trump said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him "'Did you have any idea she was a spy?'" "He said 'I had no idea she was a spy' and I really believe him," Trump told reporters. What investigations are now under way? Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into the affair and has hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to carry out the probe. The investigation will be led by former US Attorney for New York's Southern District, Joon Kim. US President Donald Trump said on Monday that the FBI was also investigating the affair. The FBI declined to comment further when contacted by the BBC. Jensen Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November. Members of the US House Foreign Affairs Committee asked the Nvidia chief executive to appear to explain his interactions with Alice Huang, as well as Nvidia's security protocols around espionage. Jensen Huang has yet to say he will comply, a person familiar with the committee's demand told the BBC. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Jensen Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Jensen Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. Huang bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure like Amazon, Google and Microsoft now use Nvidia chips. Currently worth about $4tn, Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. For now, the firm's board appears unlikely to remove Jensen Huang, saying on Sunday they have "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team". Sources tell the BBC his removal is unlikely because there is so much money at stake. There is no public succession plan for the 63-year-old. He has often said he hopes to continue in the role for decades, and Bloomberg reports he has created an informal leadership structure around him unlike a traditional company's hierarchy. His children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez work at Nvidia in senior roles. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters: "The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." The New York Times reported in late October that US President Donald Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he wished he had "acted on the intelligence", Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's [Jensen Huang] an honourable guy." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Jensen Huang. Last spring, the secretary of state reportedly oversaw the drafting of a memo that warned the Trump administration about Jensen Huang's relationship with the Chinese businesswoman. - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published23 hours ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published8 hours ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among American lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of US companies like Nvidia, working with producers like the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Jensen Huang once saying that Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. Huang has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. Sunday's revelations may explain why Jensen Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. Jensen Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Jensen Huang. Trump said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him "'Did you have any idea she was a spy?'" "He said 'I had no idea she was a spy' and I really believe him," Trump told reporters. What investigations are now under way? Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into the affair and has hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to carry out the probe. The investigation will be led by former US Attorney for New York's Southern District, Joon Kim. US President Donald Trump said on Monday that the FBI was also investigating the affair. The FBI declined to comment further when contacted by the BBC. Jensen Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November. Members of the US House Foreign Affairs Committee asked the Nvidia chief executive to appear to explain his interactions with Alice Huang, as well as Nvidia's security protocols around espionage. Jensen Huang has yet to say he will comply, a person familiar with the committee's demand told the BBC. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Jensen Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Jensen Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. Huang bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure like Amazon, Google and Microsoft now use Nvidia chips. Currently worth about $4tn, Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies in the world. For now, the firm's board appears unlikely to remove Jensen Huang, saying on Sunday they have "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team". Sources tell the BBC his removal is unlikely because there is so much money at stake. There is no public succession plan for the 63-year-old. He has often said he hopes to continue in the role for decades, and Bloomberg reports he has created an informal leadership structure around him unlike a traditional company's hierarchy. His children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez work at Nvidia in senior roles. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Jensen Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Jensen Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." news.titleTr: 121 milyar dolarlık pazarda Türkiye sürprizi: ABD pazarında yükseliş hızlandı
news.summaryTr: 121 milyar dolarlık küresel mobil oyun pazarında dengeler değişiyor. Çinli şirketler ABD'li rakiplerini geride bırakırken, Türkiye ve Singapur merkezli oyun geliştiricilerinin ABD pazarındaki toplam payı 6 yılda yüzde 1,2'den yüzde 18'e yükseldi.
news.articleText: 121 milyar dolarlık pazarda Türkiye sürprizi: ABD pazarında yükseliş hızlandı - 121 milyar dolarlık küresel mobil oyun pazarında dengeler değişiyor. Çinli şirketler ABD'li rakiplerini geride bırakırken, Türkiye ve Singapur merkezli oyun geliştiricilerinin ABD pazarındaki toplam payı 6 yılda yüzde 1,2'den yüzde 18'e yükseldi. Küresel mobil oyun sektöründe rekabetin dengesi değişiyor. Çinli oyun geliştiricileri, 121 milyar dolarlık pazarda gelir paylarını yüzde 40'a çıkararak ABD'li rakiplerine büyük fark attı. Amerikan şirketlerinin payı gerilerken, Türkiye ve Singapur merkezli oyun şirketleri özellikle ABD pazarındaki hızlı büyümeleriyle öne çıktı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sensor Tower verilerine dayandırılan araştırma, mobil oyun sektöründe son iki yılda yaşanan değişimi ortaya koydu. 2024 yılının başında dünyanın en fazla gelir elde eden 100 mobil oyununda Çinli ve ABD'li yayıncılar birbirine yakın paylara sahipken, 2026'nın ortasında tablo Çin lehine değişti. Çinli şirketlerin küresel gelir payı yüzde 40'a ulaşırken, ABD merkezli yayıncıların payı yüzde 16,5'e kadar geriledi. Çinli şirketler ABD pazarında da güçleniyor Çinli oyun geliştiricilerinin yurt dışındaki en büyük pazarı ABD oldu. Ülkede en fazla gelir sağlayan 100 mobil oyun arasında Çinli yayıncıların payı, 2020'nin başındaki yüzde 8 seviyesinden 2025'te yüzde 18'in üzerine yükseldi. Aynı dönemde ABD'li şirketlerin kendi pazarlarındaki payı yüzde 40'tan yüzde 30'un altına düştü. Çinli geliştiricilerin yükselişinde Tencent'in Honor of Kings ve Whiteout Survival gibi dünya çapında geniş oyuncu kitlelerine ulaşan yapımlarının başarısı etkili oldu. Türkiye ve Singapur'un payı yüzde 18'e ulaştı Mobil oyun pazarındaki değişimin dikkat çeken diğer oyuncuları ise Türkiye ve Singapur oldu. Sensor Tower verilerine göre, iki ülkede faaliyet gösteren yayıncıların ABD'nin en yüksek gelir elde eden 100 mobil oyunundaki toplam payı, 2020'nin ilk çeyreğinde yalnızca yüzde 1,2 seviyesindeydi. Bu oran, 2026'nın ikinci çeyreğinde yüzde 18'e kadar yükseldi. Türkiye merkezli Dream Games'in geliştirdiği Royal Match ile Singapur merkezli Garena'nın Free Fire oyunu, söz konusu büyümede öne çıkan yapımlar arasında yer aldı. Sektörde artan birleşme ve satın alma faaliyetleri de Türkiye ve Singapur merkezli şirketlerin uluslararası pazarlardaki konumunu güçlendiren unsurlar arasında gösterildi. Mobil oyun pazarı 121 milyar dolara ulaştı Mobil oyun sektörü, yıllık 121 milyar dolarlık büyüklüğüyle eğlence ekonomisinin en önemli alanlarından biri haline geldi. Gelir açısından Hollywood ve müzik akışı sektörlerini geride bırakan mobil oyun pazarında, 2026 yılı boyunca dünya genelinde 3 milyardan fazla kişinin oyun oynaması bekleniyor. Çinli geliştiricilerin küresel pazardaki ağırlığı artarken, Türkiye ve Singapur gibi ülkelerin yükselişi de mobil oyun sektöründeki rekabetin giderek daha fazla ülkeye yayıldığını gösteriyor.

news.titleTr: Dünyayı kurtaran haber | Yeşil finans piyasası 7,3 trilyon doları aştı
news.summaryTr: İklim değişikliğiyle mücadele ve enerji dönüşümü, finans piyasalarında yeni bir kaynak aktarım alanı oluşturuyor. Yeşil tahvillerden sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı kredilere, yatırım fonlarından karbon piyasalarına uzanan yeşil finans araçları, trilyonlarca dolarlık bir piyasaya dönüştü.
news.articleText: Dünyayı kurtaran haber | Yeşil finans piyasası 7,3 trilyon doları aştı - İklim değişikliğiyle mücadele ve enerji dönüşümü, finans piyasalarında yeni bir kaynak aktarım alanı oluşturuyor. Yeşil tahvillerden sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı kredilere, yatırım fonlarından karbon piyasalarına uzanan yeşil finans araçları, trilyonlarca dolarlık bir piyasaya dönüştü. - Climate Bonds Initiative verilerine göre, yeşil, sosyal, sürdürülebilirlik ve sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı borçlanma araçlarının toplamında küresel ihraç hacmi, 2026'nın ilk yarısı itibarıyla 7,3 trilyon dolara ulaştı. Yalnızca 2025'te yeşil tahvil ihraçları 653,5 milyar dolar olarak gerçekleşti. Enerji dönüşümü, temiz teknolojilerin geliştirilmesi ve çevresel projelerin hayata geçirilmesi için büyük ölçekli finansman ihtiyacı doğuruyor. Bu ihtiyacın karşılanmasında bankalar, sermaye piyasaları ve yatırım fonları giderek daha fazla rol üstleniyor. Yeşil finans olarak adlandırılan bu alan, çevresel fayda sağlamayı hedefleyen projelere kaynak aktarılmasını sağlayan finansal araçları kapsıyor. Yeşil tahviller finansman piyasasının merkezinde CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yeşil finansın en yaygın araçlarından biri yeşil tahviller. Şirketler, bankalar ve kamu kurumları tarafından ihraç edilen bu tahvillerden elde edilen kaynaklar; yenilenebilir enerji santralleri, enerji verimliliği, temiz ulaşım, su yönetimi ve atık projeleri gibi çevresel yatırımların finansmanında kullanılıyor. Birleşmiş Milletler Ticaret ve Kalkınma Konferansı'nın (UNCTAD) 2025 Dünya Yatırım Raporu'na göre, yeşil, sosyal, sürdürülebilirlik ve sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı tahvillerin küresel ihraç hacmi 2024'te 1 trilyon doları aşarak 1,05 trilyon dolara ulaştı. Bu tutar, 2023'e göre yüzde 11 artış anlamına geldi. Yeşil tahviller 672 milyar dolarlık ihraç hacmiyle toplamın en büyük bölümünü oluşturdu. Climate Bonds Initiative'in Mart 2026'da yayımladığı Sustainable Debt Global State of the Market 2025 raporuna göre, 2025'te yeşil, sosyal, sürdürülebilirlik ve sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı tahvillerin toplamında kriterlerle uyumlu ihraç hacmi 1 trilyon doların üzerinde gerçekleşti. Yeşil tahviller, bu grubun yüzde 64'ünü oluşturdu ve 653,5 milyar dolara ulaştı. Böylece yeşil tahvil ihraçları, yıllık bazda kaydedilen en yüksek ikinci seviyeye çıktı. Yeşil krediler ve sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı finansman Yeşil finans yalnızca tahvil piyasasıyla sınırlı değil. Bankalar, yenilenebilir enerji yatırımları, enerji tasarrufu sağlayan sanayi tesisleri, elektrikli ulaşım ve verimli binalar için yeşil kredi ürünleri sunuyor. Bu kredilerde finansmanın belirli çevresel projelerde kullanılması esas alınıyor. Sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı tahvil ve kredilerde ise farklı bir model uygulanıyor. Bu araçlarda sağlanan finansmanın belirli bir projeye aktarılması şartı bulunmayabiliyor. Bunun yerine şirketin karbon emisyonlarını azaltma, enerji verimliliğini artırma veya belirlenen sürdürülebilirlik hedeflerine ulaşma performansı finansman koşullarına bağlanıyor. Hedeflerin karşılanmaması durumunda faiz oranı gibi finansal koşullar değişebiliyor. Faizsiz finans ilkeleriyle çevresel yatırımları buluşturan yeşil sukuklar da bu piyasanın araçları arasında yer alıyor. Yenilenebilir enerji ve sürdürülebilir altyapı projelerinin finansmanında kullanılan bu kira sertifikaları, İslami finans piyasalarında kaynak çeşitliliği sağlıyor. Yeşil yatırım fonları ve karbon piyasaları Yeşil finansın bir diğer ayağını yatırım fonları oluşturuyor. Çevresel kriterleri karşılayan şirketlere yatırım yapan fonlar ve borsa yatırım fonları, bireysel ve kurumsal yatırımcıların temiz enerji, su teknolojileri ve çevre odaklı şirketlere sermaye aktarmasına imkân veriyor. UNCTAD'ın aynı raporuna göre, sürdürülebilir yatırım fonlarının toplam piyasa değeri 2024'te 3,2 trilyon dolara yükseldi. Bu tutar, bir önceki yıla göre yüzde 8 artış gösterdi. Bununla birlikte, söz konusu fonlara yönelik net para girişleri yıllık bazda yüzde 45 geriledi. Böylece fonların toplam büyüklüğü artarken yeni yatırım girişlerinin ivme kaybettiği bir tablo ortaya çıktı. Karbon piyasaları da şirketlerin emisyonlarını azaltma hedefleriyle finansal kaynakları buluşturan mekanizmalar arasında bulunuyor. Emisyon ticaret sistemlerinde şirketler, belirlenen sınırlar çerçevesinde karbon izinlerini alıp satabiliyor. Gönüllü karbon piyasalarında ise ağaçlandırma veya yenilenebilir enerji gibi projelerden elde edilen ve doğrulanan emisyon azaltımları karbon kredisi olarak işlem görebiliyor. UNCTAD verilerine göre, zorunlu karbon fiyatlandırma mekanizmalarından elde edilen küresel gelir 2024'te 75 milyar dolara ulaştı. Gönüllü karbon piyasasının değeri ise aynı yıl 1,4 milyar dolar olarak hesaplandı. Raporda, karbon kredilerinin güvenilirliği ve piyasa standartlarının geliştirilmesi konularındaki sorunların sürdüğü de belirtildi. Yeşil finans piyasası 2026'da da büyüyor Yeşil ve sürdürülebilir borçlanma araçlarına yönelik ihraçlar 2026'nın ilk yarısında da yüksek seviyesini korudu. Climate Bonds Initiative'in Eylül 2026'da yayımladığı Sustainable Debt Global State of the Market H1 2026 raporuna göre, yeşil, sosyal, sürdürülebilirlik ve sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı tahvillerin kriterlerle uyumlu ihraç hacmi yılın ilk altı ayında 529,7 milyar dolara ulaştı. Bu tutar, 2025'in aynı dönemine kıyasla büyük ölçüde yatay seyretti. Haziran 2026 sonu itibarıyla söz konusu araçların kümülatif kriterlerle uyumlu ihraç hacmi 7,3 trilyon dolara çıktı. Bu toplamın 4 trilyon doların üzerindeki bölümünü yeşil tahviller oluşturdu. Yeşil finans sözlüğü Sürdürülebilir ve yeşil finans dünyasındaki başlıca yeşil ve çevre odaklı yatırım araçlarının listesi: 1. Mavi Tahvil: Deniz ekosistemleri, okyanus temizliği, su arıtma ve kıyı koruma projelerini finanse eden özel tematik tahvil. news.articleTextTr: Dünyayı kurtaran haber | Yeşil finans piyasası 7,3 trilyon doları aştı - İklim değişikliğiyle mücadele ve enerji dönüşümü, finans piyasalarında yeni bir kaynak aktarım alanı oluşturuyor. Yeşil tahvillerden sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı kredilere, yatırım fonlarından karbon piyasalarına uzanan yeşil finans araçları, trilyonlarca dolarlık bir piyasaya dönüştü. - Climate Bonds Initiative verilerine göre, yeşil, sosyal, sürdürülebilirlik ve sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı borçlanma araçlarının toplamında küresel ihraç hacmi, 2026'nın ilk yarısı itibarıyla 7,3 trilyon dolara ulaştı. Yalnızca 2025'te yeşil tahvil ihraçları 653,5 milyar dolar olarak gerçekleşti. Enerji dönüşümü, temiz teknolojilerin geliştirilmesi ve çevresel projelerin hayata geçirilmesi için büyük ölçekli finansman ihtiyacı doğuruyor. Bu ihtiyacın karşılanmasında bankalar, sermaye piyasaları ve yatırım fonları giderek daha fazla rol üstleniyor. Yeşil finans olarak adlandırılan bu alan, çevresel fayda sağlamayı hedefleyen projelere kaynak aktarılmasını sağlayan finansal araçları kapsıyor. Yeşil tahviller finansman piyasasının merkezinde CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Yeşil finansın en yaygın araçlarından biri yeşil tahviller. Şirketler, bankalar ve kamu kurumları tarafından ihraç edilen bu tahvillerden elde edilen kaynaklar; yenilenebilir enerji santralleri, enerji verimliliği, temiz ulaşım, su yönetimi ve atık projeleri gibi çevresel yatırımların finansmanında kullanılıyor. Birleşmiş Milletler Ticaret ve Kalkınma Konferansı'nın (UNCTAD) 2025 Dünya Yatırım Raporu'na göre, yeşil, sosyal, sürdürülebilirlik ve sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı tahvillerin küresel ihraç hacmi 2024'te 1 trilyon doları aşarak 1,05 trilyon dolara ulaştı. Bu tutar, 2023'e göre yüzde 11 artış anlamına geldi. Yeşil tahviller 672 milyar dolarlık ihraç hacmiyle toplamın en büyük bölümünü oluşturdu. Climate Bonds Initiative'in Mart 2026'da yayımladığı Sustainable Debt Global State of the Market 2025 raporuna göre, 2025'te yeşil, sosyal, sürdürülebilirlik ve sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı tahvillerin toplamında kriterlerle uyumlu ihraç hacmi 1 trilyon doların üzerinde gerçekleşti. Yeşil tahviller, bu grubun yüzde 64'ünü oluşturdu ve 653,5 milyar dolara ulaştı. Böylece yeşil tahvil ihraçları, yıllık bazda kaydedilen en yüksek ikinci seviyeye çıktı. Yeşil krediler ve sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı finansman Yeşil finans yalnızca tahvil piyasasıyla sınırlı değil. Bankalar, yenilenebilir enerji yatırımları, enerji tasarrufu sağlayan sanayi tesisleri, elektrikli ulaşım ve verimli binalar için yeşil kredi ürünleri sunuyor. Bu kredilerde finansmanın belirli çevresel projelerde kullanılması esas alınıyor. Sürdürülebilirlik bağlantılı tahvil ve kredilerde ise farklı bir model uygulanıyor. Bu araçlarda sağlanan finansmanın belirli bir projeye aktarılması şartı bulunmayabiliyor. Bunun yerine şirketin karbon emisyonlarını azaltma, enerji verimliliğini artırma veya belirlenen sürdürülebilirlik hedeflerine ulaşma performansı finansman koşullarına bağlanıyor. Hedeflerin karşılanmaması durumunda faiz oranı gibi finansal koşullar değişebiliyor. Faizsiz finans ilkeleriyle çevresel yatırımları buluşturan yeşil sukuklar da bu piyasanın araçları arasında yer alıyor. Yenilenebilir enerji ve sürdürülebilir altyapı projelerinin finansmanında kullanılan bu kira sertifikaları, İslami finans piyasalarında kaynak çeşitliliği sağlıyor. Çevresel kriterleri karşılayan şirketlere yatırım yapan fonlar ve borsa yatırım fonları, bireysel ve kurumsal yatırımcıların temiz enerji, su teknolojileri ve çevre odaklı şirketlere sermaye aktarmasına imkân veriyor. Böylece fonların toplam büyüklüğü artarken yeni yatırım girişlerinin ivme kaybettiği bir tablo ortaya çıktı. Gönüllü karbon piyasalarında ise ağaçlandırma veya yenilenebilir enerji gibi projelerden elde edilen ve doğrulanan emisyon azaltımları karbon kredisi olarak işlem görebiliyor. news.summaryTr: Info Yatırım Danışmanlığı Direktörü İsmail Güner, Borsa İstanbul'da tepki yükselişinin bir süre daha devam edebileceğini belirtti. Endekste yeni hedeflere işaret eden Güner, yükselişin ardından yeniden satış baskısı yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu.
news.articleText: Borsada yükseliş için yeni hedef geldi: Sonrasında yön değişebilir Info Yatırım Danışmanlığı Direktörü İsmail Güner, Borsa İstanbul'da tepki yükselişinin bir süre daha devam edebileceğini belirtti. Endekste yeni hedeflere işaret eden Güner, yükselişin ardından yeniden satış baskısı yaşanabileceği uyarısında bulundu. Info Yatırım Danışmanlığı Direktörü İsmail Güner, CNBC-e'de yayınlanan Para Ekranı programında Şafak Tükle'nin sorularını yanıtladı. Borsa İstanbul'daki son yükselişi değerlendiren Güner, piyasada toparlanma eğiliminin sürdüğünü ancak mevcut hareketin henüz kalıcı bir yükseliş trendine dönüşmediğini ifade etti. Küresel piyasalarla Borsa İstanbul arasında şu anda belirgin bir korelasyon bulunmadığını söyleyen Güner, endeksteki yükselişin daha önce yaşanan sert kayıpların ardından gelen tepki hareketi olduğunu vurguladı. Bilanço döneminin tamamlanmasıyla piyasa üzerindeki baskılardan birinin ortadan kalktığını belirten Güner, güçlü finansal sonuçlar açıklayan şirketlerin pozitif ayrışmaya devam ettiğini söyledi. Bankacılık sektörü piyasayı taşıyor BIST 30 hisselerinde yukarı yönlü eğilimin sınırlı da olsa ağırlık kazandığını belirten Güner, özellikle bankacılık sektörünün endekse destek verdiğine dikkat çekti. Güner, "Bankacılık sektörü biraz daha piyasayı taşıyor diyebiliriz. Bankacılıkta bir bozulma olmadığı sürece diğer sektörlerdeki düşüşler de sınırlı olur" değerlendirmesinde bulundu. Borsa İstanbul'da 12.000 puan civarında bir fiyat boşluğu bulunduğunu ifade eden Güner, endeksin bu bölgeye doğru hareketini sürdürebileceğini söyledi. Borsada 12.500 puan ihtimali Endekste kısa vadeli görünümün olumlu olduğunu belirten Güner, koşulların iyileşmesi halinde yükselişin 12.500 puana kadar devam edebileceğini dile getirdi. Güner, "İşler biraz daha olumluya dönerse 12.500'e doğru bir yükselişin devam etmesini bekleyebiliriz" dedi. Son dönemdeki yükselişin bir bölümünün geri verilebileceğini ancak Türkiye piyasaları açısından belirgin olumsuz gündem başlıklarının azaldığını ifade eden Güner, fonlarla ilgili gelişmelerin de piyasa üzerindeki etkisinin giderek zayıfladığını söyledi. Bundan sonraki süreçte hem yurt dışından gelecek haberlerin hem de yurt içindeki gelişmelerin piyasanın yönünü belirleyeceğini kaydetti. Yeni yükseliş trendi için 13.000 puan şartı Borsa İstanbul'un teknik görünümünü Elliott Dalga Teorisi çerçevesinde değerlendiren Güner, mevcut hareketin henüz yeni bir yükseliş trendinin başladığına işaret etmediğini belirtti. Güner, "Elliott analizi şu anda tepki yükselişinin devam ettiğini gösteriyor. Fakat henüz burada yeni bir yükseliş trendi başlıyor demiyor. Sadece bir tepki yükselişi içinde olduğumuzu ve bunun bir süre daha devam edebileceğini gösteriyor" ifadelerini kullandı. Endekste 12.500 puana kadar yükseliş potansiyelinin yüksek olduğunu söyleyen Güner, asıl kritik seviyenin 13.000 puan olduğunu vurguladı. Güner, "Bizim Borsa İstanbul'da yeni bir yükselişten bahsedebilmemiz için 13.000'lerin üstüne çıkmamız gerek. O zaman düşüş trendi iptal oluyor ve yeni bir beş dalgalık yükseliş trendinin başlama ihtimalini konuşabiliriz" dedi. Mevcut teknik görünümün yükselişin ardından yeniden satış baskısı oluşabileceğine işaret ettiğini belirten Güner, 13.000 puan aşılmadığı sürece hareketin tepki yükselişi olarak değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini ifade etti.

Sadece bir tepki yükselişi içinde olduğumuzu ve bunun bir süre daha devam edebileceğini gösteriyor" ifadelerini kullandı. Endekste 12.500 puana kadar yükseliş potansiyelinin yüksek olduğunu söyleyen Güner, asıl kritik seviyenin 13.000 puan olduğunu vurguladı. Güner, "Bizim Borsa İstanbul'da yeni bir yükselişten bahsedebilmemiz için 13.000'lerin üstüne çıkmamız gerek. O zaman düşüş trendi iptal oluyor ve yeni bir beş dalgalık yükseliş trendinin başlama ihtimalini konuşabiliriz" dedi. Mevcut teknik görünümün yükselişin ardından yeniden satış baskısı oluşabileceğine işaret ettiğini belirten Güner, 13.000 puan aşılmadığı sürece hareketin tepki yükselişi olarak değerlendirilmesi gerektiğini ifade etti.

news.titleTr: Almanya'da enflasyon ekimde yüzde 2,8'e geriledi
news.summaryTr: Almanya'da yıllık enflasyon, ekimde yüzde 2,8'e gerileyerek yeniden yüzde 3'ün altına indi. Enerji fiyatları yıllık bazda yüzde 12,2 artarken, çekirdek enflasyon yüzde 2,1'e düştü.
news.articleText: Almanya'da enflasyon ekimde yüzde 2,8'e geriledi - Almanya'da yıllık enflasyon, ekimde yüzde 2,8'e gerileyerek yeniden yüzde 3'ün altına indi. Enerji fiyatları yıllık bazda yüzde 12,2 artarken, çekirdek enflasyon yüzde 2,1'e düştü. Almanya'da yıllık enflasyon, ekim ayında yüzde 2,8'e gerileyerek yeniden yüzde 3'ün altına indi. Enerji fiyatlarındaki artış enflasyon üzerinde etkisini sürdürürken, akaryakıt indiriminin fiyat artışını sınırladığı değerlendirildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Almanya Federal İstatistik Ofisi (Destatis), Ekim 2026 dönemine ilişkin nihai enflasyon verilerini açıkladı. Buna göre, Tüketici Fiyat Endeksi (TÜFE) ekimde yıllık bazda yüzde 2,8 arttı. Yıllık enflasyon eylülde yüzde 3,3, ağustosta ise yüzde 2,9 seviyesinde gerçekleşmişti. TÜFE, ekimde bir önceki aya göre yüzde 0,2 geriledi. Avrupa Birliği (AB) genelinde karşılaştırmalarda kullanılan uyumlaştırılmış tüketici fiyat endeksi (HICP) ise yıllık yüzde 2,8 artarken aylık yüzde 0,1 düşüş gösterdi. Destatis Başkanı Ruth Brand, enflasyonun yeniden yüzde 3'ün biraz altına indiğini belirterek, enerji fiyatlarındaki gelişmelerin enflasyonun temel belirleyicisi olmaya devam ettiğini ifade etti. Brand, 1 Ekim'de yürürlüğe giren yeni akaryakıt indiriminin fiyat artışını bir miktar sınırlamış olabileceğini kaydetti. Enerji fiyatları yıllık yüzde 12,2 arttı Enerji ürünlerinin fiyatları ekimde geçen yılın aynı ayına göre yüzde 12,2 yükseldi. Bu oran eylülde yüzde 14,9, ağustosta yüzde 10,5, temmuzda ise yüzde 8,3 olarak kaydedilmişti. Akaryakıt fiyatları yıllık bazda yüzde 28,9 artarken, eylülde bu oran yüzde 37,1 seviyesindeydi. Kalorifer yakıtı fiyatları yüzde 84,5, odun ve pelet gibi katı yakıtların fiyatları ise yüzde 14,5 yükseldi. Buna karşılık elektrik fiyatları yüzde 5,2, doğal gaz fiyatları ise yüzde 1,2 geriledi. Gıda fiyatlarındaki artış yüzde 0,4'te kaldı Gıda fiyatları ekimde yıllık bazda yüzde 0,4 artarak genel enflasyonun altında kaldı. Bu oran eylül ayında da aynı seviyedeydi. Yumurta fiyatları yüzde 15,4, taze sebze ve patates fiyatları yüzde 11,5, balık ve deniz ürünleri fiyatları yüzde 4,5 yükseldi. Buna karşılık yenilebilir yağ ve katı yağ fiyatları yüzde 9,1, süt ürünleri yüzde 4,7, taze meyve fiyatları yüzde 2,8 geriledi. Tereyağı fiyatlarındaki düşüş ise yüzde 18,9 oldu. Çekirdek enflasyon yüzde 2,1'e geriledi Enerji ve gıda fiyatları hariç tutularak hesaplanan çekirdek enflasyon, ekimde yüzde 2,1 olarak gerçekleşti. Çekirdek enflasyon temmuz, ağustos ve eylül aylarında yüzde 2,4 seviyesindeydi. Mal fiyatları yıllık bazda yüzde 3 artarken, dayanıklı tüketim mallarındaki artış yüzde 0,3'te kaldı. Dayanıksız tüketim mallarının fiyatları ise enerji maliyetlerinin etkisiyle yüzde 4,7 yükseldi. Bilgi işlem ekipmanlarının fiyatları yüzde 9,9 artarken, tütün ürünlerinde artış yüzde 5,9 oldu.

news.titleTr: Electricity bills to rise by 2.5% from March
news.summaryTr: The increase will add just over £1 per week for a typical all-electric home, Jersey Electricity says.
news.articleText: Electricity bills to rise by 2.5% from March - Published Electricity bills will go up by 2.5% in Jersey from March 2027, it has been announced. Jersey Electricity said the tariff increase would add just over £1 per week for a typical all-electric home from March 2027. The annual rate of inflation in Jersey rose to 3% in September, according to the latest figures. Chief executive Chris Ambler said: "We know that any increase in household costs is unwelcome, so we have worked hard to keep this rise below the island's current rate of inflation. " Ambler said: "We have again delayed the increase until March, which means it will not affect customers during the colder winter months when electricity consumption is generally at its highest." The company said it was investing £120m in the network to better its resilience and future-proof its systems. It said it continued to focus on managing costs responsibly and driving efficiencies across the business. Follow BBC Jersey on X, external, Facebook, external and Instagram, external. news.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, pro-crypto lawmaker Tom Emmer was elected House Republican minority whip as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress, hotter-than-expected US inflation raised concerns about a potential half-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December, and Coinbase, Kalshi and other trading firms backed the CFTC in a legal battle over perpetual futures tied to US stocks. Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip Pro-crypto US Representative Tom Emmer has been elected House Republican minority whip, securing the party’s second-highest leadership position as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress in January. Emmer beat Texas Representative August Pfluger in a 103-76 secret ballot vote, according to Politico. He previously served as House Republican majority whip and will remain the party’s No. 2 leader, this time under incoming Minority Leader Jim Jordan. As minority whip, Emmer will be responsible for rallying Republican votes, coordinating the party’s legislative strategy and helping maintain unity on key bills. “Tom has been one of the strongest advocates for digital assets in Congress, and he has led the fight against a government-controlled CBDC and stood up for American innovators,” GOP Senator Cynthia Lummis said on X. Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December Crypto industry experts warned on Tuesday that higher-than-expected US inflation could lead to a another Federal Reserve interest rate hike, making borrowing more expensive and potentially discouraging investment in cryptocurrencies. The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month over month in October, above economists’ forecast of 0.3%, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics - a slower increase than September’s 0.6% rise. Core inflation, which excludes food and energy prices, rose 0.3%, above the expected 0.2%. Currently, the Federal Reserve holds its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4.00%, after raising it by a quarter-point in September and leaving it unchanged in October. The report came just a few hours after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said in London that another core inflation reading of 0.3% or higher could prompt the Fed to consider a larger interest rate hike in December. “In that case, I believe a 50-basis-point hike in the policy rate should be considered at the December meeting,” Waller said. “Hiking only 25-basis-points would put our credibility at risk, a risk I am not eager to take.” Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies asked a federal court Monday to accept a brief backing the United States Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) in a lawsuit over perpetual futures tied to individual US stocks. According to a proposed amicus brief shared Monday by Coinbase legal representative Molly Abraham, the group also includes Kraken parent Payward, trading companies DRW Holdings and Jump Trading, and crypto investment company Paradigm Operations. The companies argue that stock perpetual futures fall under existing US futures laws. The filing comes days after a federal judge found that the CFTC likely “exceeded its statutory authority” in allowing single-stock perpetuals to trade as security futures. The case could determine whether US exchanges can offer retail traders contracts that track individual stocks without expiring. On Nov. 3, the CFTC announced that single-stock perpetual futures, or stock perps, could begin trading on US-regulated exchanges for the first time. The Capital Markets Alliance Association (CMAA), a newly formed trade and advocacy group representing traditional financial market participants and whose members include Cboe and Citadel Securities, sued the CFTC last week, challenging the CFTC’s authority to allow the contracts to trade.

news.summary: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.

news.titleTr: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
news.summaryTr: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.
news.articleText: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network. Layer-1 blockchain network Initia confirmed Wednesday that it has suffered its second security exploit in less than three weeks, with an attacker stealing about $3.27 million in crypto assets after compromising the platform’s cloud infrastructure. On Wednesday, Initia said the attacker gained unauthorized access on Monday through a command injection attack involving a compromised Google Cloud Platform key. The company said the breach exposed environment variables, allowing the attacker to access Initia’s GitHub and cloud accounts and obtain additional credentials. According to Initia, the attacker accessed Anvil, a platform hosting rollups, and validated fraudulent Inter-Blockchain Communication (IBC) withdrawals from five rollups, releasing assets held in the network’s escrow accounts. Initia said about $2.16 million of the stolen assets remain frozen on its halted network. The attacker sold assets on Initia’s decentralized exchange and withdrew 13,400 TIA, 8,000 USDC.inj and 597,000 Noble USDC. No INIT tokens were withdrawn. Initia halted its layer-1 on Tuesday and said it intends to restore the backing of affected assets. The blockchain said recovery efforts are ongoing with its law enforcement and security partners. The incident follows an Oct. 23 exploit that saw an attacker drain about $2.7 million after exploiting a vulnerability in Initia’s MoveVM script cache. This allowed malicious code to bypass security checks and create unbacked token balances that were subsequently bridged out of the network. news.title: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave
news.summary: Nine members of the political dynasty say the 250ft structure would cast a shadow on gravesites.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave
news.summaryTr: Nine members of the political dynasty say the 250ft structure would cast a shadow on gravesites.
news.articleText: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch, arguing it would cast shadow on JFK's grave - Published The family of former US President John F Kennedy has sued to block construction of a triumphal arch that President Donald Trump plans to build in the nation's capital. Nine members of the political dynasty argue the 250ft (76m) structure would block the view of Kennedy's grave, as well as the graves of thousands of veterans buried at Arlington National Cemetery in Virginia. Last week, a US judge temporarily halted the project on the heels of a vote allowing construction to proceed. The White House said it was "unfortunate" to see that some members of the Kennedy family had joined litigation against an arch "intended to honor our heroes who rest in Arlington Cemetery". "The judiciary should not be abused to politicize a structure designed to unite our nation," White House spokesman Davis R Ingle said in a statement to the BBC. "We will continue making the case for this beautiful and fitting monument and are confident we will be fully vindicated as this litigation proceeds," he added. Last week the project won approval from the National Capital Planning Commission. But US District Judge Tanya Chutkan then ruled there should be a 14-day pause before any work can start on the arch as litigation plays out. The Kennedy family filed its complaint under a joint lawsuit brought by the state of Virginia and Washington DC seeking to block construction, arguing that the arch will damage "historically significant sightlines" if erected at the gateway of the cemetery. The plaintiffs include seven children of Robert and Ethel Kennedy, as well as their grandson - former Democrat congressman Joe Kennedy - and Ted Kennedy's son Edward Kennedy Jr. It does not include Trump cabinet official Robert F Kennedy Jr, who leads the Department of Health and Human Services. Their motion moves to intervene in two other lawsuits filed by conservationists and veterans seeking to halt the construction. They say the arch would be a "permanent denigration" of the gravesites and that the Kennedy offspring "would never again be able to appreciate both sites as they always have before, and as the Kennedy family always intended". The Kennedy family argues the structure "will permanently cast shadows over and damage historically significant sightlines to the existing gravesites and memorials established in the Kennedy family's honor" at the cemetery. The structure would also "fundamentally alter the experience of visiting the gravesites", including the memorials of hundreds of thousands of US veterans, the Kennedys said. The complaint said that the National Park Service and Interior Department authorised construction on 5 November 2026 without the necessary congressional approval. The so-called Arc de Trump is one of the president's efforts to remake the capital city and is meant to commemorate the country's 250th anniversary. Last year, he also added his name to the Kennedy Center, a major Washington DC cultural institution named in honour of JFK. Trump's name remained on the facade for six months until the addition was ruled illegal and removed. Related topics - Published21 May - Published25 September - Published4 days ago

news.title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
news.summary: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
news.summaryTr: Trump welcomes the outcome, praising Hegseth as a "Great American Patriot", but Democrats can try again next year.
news.articleText: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now - Published An effort to impeach US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of waging war on Iran without congressional authorisation, has failed on Capitol Hill. A majority of the House of Representatives agreed to refer impeachment articles to a committee - essentially killing the effort introduced by dissident Republican congressman Thomas Massie of Kentucky - for now. In his first news briefing from the Pentagon in six months, Hegseth called the impeachment effort a "farce" and "sabotage". The bid to find the cabinet secretary guilty of misconduct and ultimately remove him from office was seen as a long shot as it could have required a number of other Republicans to defy President Donald Trump. Massie was the only Republican to vote against moving the resolution to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee on Tuesday. His effort failed in a 211-204 vote, with more than a dozen members, including 11 Democrats, missing the vote. The move to send the measure to the panel effectively kills the effort, as there is only a short period of time left in this Congress before Democrats take control in January. President Trump celebrated the vote in a post on Truth Social, saying the effort "has miserably FAILED". "Again, Victories in Venezuela and Iran, the Best Recruitment Numbers in the History of the Military (Long waiting lists to get in!), and Spirit like rarely seen before, led to the EXONERATION of a Great American Patriot," Trump said, referring to Hegseth. After the vote, Massie said he "wasn't surprised" but "was disappointed", according to BBC's US media partner CBS. "My diagnosis of Congress is these people know what to do," he added. "They just can't bring themselves to do it, even when it would benefit them politically." Massie had previously acknowledged his impeachment bid may not succeed immediately, but argued it could help push Trump to replace Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process. The Kentucky congressman also said that removing Hegseth now would give the Senate time to approve a replacement while Republicans were still in power. Impeachment resolutions can be carried past the end of a congressional term, meaning Democrats would be able to take it up next year. The Democrats will take control of both chambers of Congress in January following a successful midterm election that allowed them control of both chambers. House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Republican, had predicted earlier in the day that the impeachment bid would fail. In the eight articles of impeachment formally introduced in the House on Monday, Massie said Hegseth was "breaking the law and must be held accountable" for fighting a war in Iran for more than 90 days without lawmakers' approval. The impeachment articles also accused Hegseth of overseeing "extrajudicial killings" in the US campaign against boats alleged to be carrying drugs in the Pacific Ocean and Caribbean Sea. At a news conference on Tuesday, Hegseth called efforts to impeach him a political stunt by a Trump administration opponent who was "disgruntled and defeated". Hegseth also argued Massie's resolution endangered national security, because it communicated to US adversaries "that the United States will actually punish its own warriors and its own civilian leadership for successfully executing lawful military operations". "This is not patriotism. This is sabotage," he said. He echoed some statements Trump had made during a surprise appearance at the White House briefing room on Monday, including touting a rise in military recruitment levels. But Hegseth said Massie was motivated by policy differences and "not high crimes, not misdemeanours, not treason, not bribery, not the kinds of offences the founders intended when they wrote the impeachment clause". Massie, who lost re-election earlier this year to a Trump-backed opponent, has been critical of Trump and the war in Iran since it began in February. He had already incurred the president's ire for demanding the Trump administration release files on deceased sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. While Hegseth has survived politically for now, many lawmakers - including some Republicans - have questioned how long he can last in the administration. Texas Senator Ted Cruz, a Republican, said on Tuesday he expected Hegseth to resign or be fired by Trump. - Published2 days ago

news.titleTr: Headquarters of Haitian gang destroyed, El Salvador's president says
news.summaryTr: The infamous 400 Mawozo gang was targeted by the El Salvador military which has deployed thousands of troops to combat Haiti's gang violence crisis.
news.articleText: Headquarters of Haitian gang destroyed, El Salvador's president says - Published The headquarters of one of Haiti's largest crime gangs has been destroyed by El Salvador's military, the Salvadoran president has said. The infamous 400 Mawozo gang, which is known for kidnappings and intimidation tactics, was targeted in a ground and air attack at a complex on the outskirts of Haiti's capital, Port-au-Prince. It is El Salvador's first military action on a Haitian target since it deployed more than 2,000 soldiers there last month, as part of a mission to rescue four missing Salvadoran technicians. Haiti has been plagued by gang violence for years, with heavily armed groups controlling large parts of the capital, and beyond. El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele announced the news on X, external, boasting that most of the gang members fled without trying to fight. "We destroyed the house of [gang leader] Lanmò San Jou and the 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters," he wrote on Tuesday. The post was accompanied by video of several helicopters firing on a large complex, reportedly in the suburb of Croix-des-Bouquets, the gang's stronghold. As the helicopters circle above, dozens of people can be seen running out of the property, fleeing the strikes. Several media outlets have reported that as many as 20 people were killed, however that has not been confirmed by authorities. There has also been no official confirmation of the extent of the damage at the property, with Haitians questioning whether it has been destroyed or just damaged. The Miami Herald reports that the gang's leader, Wilson "Lanmò San Jou" Joseph, was not there at the time. The BBC has not been able to verify the video posted by Bukele, nor whether the property is indeed the gang's headquarters. Haiti's National Police drone task force was involved in the attack, supported by Salvadoran soldiers, the Miami Herald reports, citing several sources. Posting on X after the strikes, Haitian Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé thanked the Salvadoran military's commitment "in the fight against gangs", and said the two nations would keep working together, along with the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF), to "regain control of the territory and restore state authority". "THE GANGS WILL GET NO SLEEP!" he added. Some 2,000 Salvadoran soldiers were deployed to Haiti last month after four air force technicians were abducted at gunpoint while food shopping in October. El Salvador's right-wing president has vowed to bring the men home alive and warned the gang to release them immediately or face sustained pressure from his military. The four abducted men were working as part of the GSF, made up of troops from several nations, initially led by soldiers from Chad. President Bukele's move to send thousands of Salvadoran troops to Haiti has raised concerns, with critics saying they are not all working within the command structure of the GSF. It has raised questions about the operational legitimacy and legality of their actions in the Caribbean nation. Amnesty International has urged both countries to "ensure all operations conducted by Salvadoran forces in Haiti comply with international human rights law". Such concerns do not appear to phase Bukele, however, who continues to directly warn and target the gang leaders. The infamous 400 Mawozo gang, which is known for kidnappings and intimidation tactics, was targeted in a ground and air attack at a complex on the outskirts of Haiti's capital, Port-au-Prince. It is El Salvador's first military action on a Haitian target since it deployed more than 2,000 soldiers there last month, as part of a mission to rescue four missing Salvadoran technicians. Haiti has been plagued by gang violence for years, with heavily armed groups controlling large parts of the capital, and beyond. El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele announced the news on X, external, boasting that most of the gang members fled without trying to fight. "We destroyed the house of [gang leader] Lanmò San Jou and the 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters," he wrote on Tuesday. The post was accompanied by video of several helicopters firing on a large complex, reportedly in the suburb of Croix-des-Bouquets, the gang's stronghold. As the helicopters circle above, dozens of people can be seen running out of the property, fleeing the strikes. Several media outlets have reported that as many as 20 people were killed, however that has not been confirmed by authorities. There has also been no official confirmation of the extent of the damage at the property, with Haitians questioning whether it has been destroyed or just damaged. The Miami Herald reports that the gang's leader, Wilson "Lanmò San Jou" Joseph, was not there at the time. The BBC has not been able to verify the video posted by Bukele, nor whether the property is indeed the gang's headquarters. Haiti's National Police drone task force was involved in the attack, supported by Salvadoran soldiers, the Miami Herald reports, citing several sources. Posting on X after the strikes, Haitian Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé thanked the Salvadoran military's commitment "in the fight against gangs", and said the two nations would keep working together, along with the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF), to "regain control of the territory and restore state authority". "THE GANGS WILL GET NO SLEEP!" he added. Some 2,000 Salvadoran soldiers were deployed to Haiti last month after four air force technicians were abducted at gunpoint while food shopping in October. El Salvador's right-wing president has vowed to bring the men home alive and warned the gang to release them immediately or face sustained pressure from his military. items.title: Christmas toy rush being driven by stickers and building sets
items.summary: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Christmas toy rush being driven by stickers and building sets
items.summaryTr: A bumper year so far for toy sales comes as debate intensifies over screen time and tech connectivity.
items.articleText: Christmas toy rush being driven by stickers and building sets - Published Traditional games and stickers are helping to drive a bumper year for toy sales, figures show. The data comes ahead of the crucial Christmas run-in for retailers, which peaks at 23 toys sold every second in the UK. The number of toys sold up to October was 17% higher than the same period last year and growth is at a 10-year high, according to research company Circana. The increase comes despite consumers' cost-of-living pressures, and there are signs that some of the biggest growth in sales is for toys priced between £5 and £10. Despite relatively low sales in recent years, the toy sector has been buoyed by sales to "kidults". The kidult market - which is toys and games for those aged over 12 - has been growing, particularly as adults buy toys for themselves. This growth has continued with a 22% increase in the value of sales in the first half of the year. But Melissa Symonds, UK toys director at Circana, said that toys for children - which still represents the majority of sales - had recorded a good year so far. Growing public debate around children's screen time and the role of technology meant squishy toys, stickers and building sets such as Lego were popular. "Connected toys account for less than 1% of market sales, showing that traditional, hands-on play remains overwhelmingly popular," she said. Concerns have been raised about the suitability of some connected devices. A BBC investigation found an AI teddy marketed as being "perfect" for children as young as three said "I can't help with killing you" after seemingly mishearing a question. Meanwhile, debate has intensified about keeping youngsters free from smartphones during the school day. One in five parents of children aged three to nine say the chance to play together as a family influences what they buy, according to market intelligence company The Insights Family. Paul Reader, who chairs the Dream Toys selection panel of retailers and experts across the sector, said that parents wanted to engage with their children's play. "Nothing beats a board game with that. Nothing beats a bit of interaction," he said. 'Shop around but check safety' The panel he chairs has selected a list of toys that retailers believe will be some of the most popular this year. It includes variations on popular toys of recent years, including slime, a soft tiger that roars and grows, and a shark that breaks out of an egg. Symonds said that, despite rising sales in the year so far, nearly half of toy sales came in the build-up to Christmas, and families were still looking closely at costs. There was significant growth in toys priced between £5 and £10, she said. Reader also urged anyone looking for a bargain to shop around, but to ensure that toys were bought from reputable traders so they were genuine and safe. items.articleText: Kazakistan ve BAE'de yeni projeler: Borsadaki şirketten 4,5 milyon dolarlık üç anlaşma - Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören Hareket Proje Taşımacılığı (HRKET), aynı gün yaptığı iki ayrı KAP açıklamasıyla toplam 4,5 milyon dolar değerinde üç yeni sözleşme imzaladığını duyurdu. Şirket, yeni anlaşmaların cirosuna olumlu katkı sağlamasını bekliyor. Hareket Proje Taşımacılığı ve Yük Mühendisliği A.Ş. (HRKET), 11 Kasım 2026 tarihinde Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) yaptığı iki ayrı açıklamada, toplam 4,5 milyon dolar değerinde yeni iş anlaşmalarına imza attığını bildirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketin ilk açıklamasına göre, Kazakistan ve Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri'nde yürütülen projeler kapsamında ağır nakliye taşımacılığı ve vinç kiralama hizmetleri için anlaşma sağlandı. Söz konusu anlaşmanın toplam bedeli 2,5 milyon dolar olarak açıklandı. Üç ay sürecek iki yeni proje Şirketin ikinci KAP açıklamasında ise vagon taşımacılığı ve proje kargo taşımacılığı hizmetlerine yönelik iki ayrı sözleşme imzalandığı belirtildi. Toplam 2 milyon dolar bedelli sözleşmeler kapsamında yürütülecek projelerin üç ay sürmesi planlanıyor. Böylece şirketin aynı gün duyurduğu yeni iş anlaşmalarının toplam büyüklüğü 4,5 milyon dolara ulaştı. Hareket Proje Taşımacılığı, her iki açıklamasında da yeni iş ilişkilerinin şirket cirosuna olumlu etki yapmasının beklendiğini ifade etti.

items.title: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
items.summary: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy
items.summaryTr: The billionaire tech executive finds himself mired in a personal and national security scandal.
items.articleText: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published One of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry's most important figures has been accused of having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang admitted, external to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US tech giant Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, has opened an independent investigation into the affair. It said it does not believe US national security had been compromised - and added that Jensen Huang was committed to continuing to lead the company. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. Who is Alice Huang and what do we know about the affair? US officials believed that Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. Her current whereabouts are unknown. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. The firm had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia maintains was investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singapore government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. She did not respond to the paper's request for comment. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. "We trust that if we were the target of a genuine threat, the US government would have notified us," an Nvidia spokesperson told the BBC. China has rejected the spying allegations. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters: "The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." The New York Times reported in late October that US President Donald Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he wished he had "acted on the intelligence", Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's [Jensen Huang] an honourable guy." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Jensen Huang. Last spring, the secretary of state reportedly oversaw the drafting of a memo that warned the Trump administration about Jensen Huang's relationship with the Chinese businesswoman. - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published23 hours ago - Nvidia hires major New York law firm to investigate Jensen Huang affair - Published8 hours ago Why does it matter? Nvidia is at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among American lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of US companies like Nvidia, working with producers like the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Jensen Huang once saying that Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. Huang has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. Sunday's revelations may explain why Jensen Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Jensen Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. Jensen Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on the Jensen Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. The Nvidia co-founder has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Jensen Huang. Trump said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him "'Did you have any idea she was a spy?'" "He said 'I had no idea she was a spy' and I really believe him," Trump told reporters. What investigations are now under way? Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into the affair and has hired New York law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to carry out the probe. The investigation will be led by former US Attorney for New York's Southern District, Joon Kim. US President Donald Trump said on Monday that the FBI was also investigating the affair. The FBI declined to comment further when contacted by the BBC. Jensen Huang has also been asked to appear for a joint closed-door briefing for several Congressional committees on 18 November. Members of the US House Foreign Affairs Committee asked the Nvidia chief executive to appear to explain his interactions with Alice Huang, as well as Nvidia's security protocols around espionage. Jensen Huang has yet to say he will comply, a person familiar with the committee's demand told the BBC. What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Jensen Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Jensen Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. Huang bet on AI at a time when "there were no customers for the stuff he was building", Witt told the BBC. items.articleTextTr: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published One of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry's most important figures has been accused of having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang admitted, external to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US tech giant Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, has opened an independent investigation into the affair. It said it does not believe US national security had been compromised - and added that Jensen Huang was committed to continuing to lead the company. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. Who is Alice Huang and what do we know about the affair? US officials believed that Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. Her current whereabouts are unknown. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. The firm had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia maintains was investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singapore government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang. It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. She did not respond to the paper's request for comment. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. "We trust that if we were the target of a genuine threat, the US government would have notified us," an Nvidia spokesperson told the BBC. China has rejected the spying allegations. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters: "The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he wished he had "acted on the intelligence", Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's [Jensen Huang] an honourable guy." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Jensen Huang. Nvidia is at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among American lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of US companies like Nvidia, working with producers like the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. items.articleText: 121 milyar dolarlık pazarda Türkiye sürprizi: ABD pazarında yükseliş hızlandı - 121 milyar dolarlık küresel mobil oyun pazarında dengeler değişiyor. Çinli şirketler ABD'li rakiplerini geride bırakırken, Türkiye ve Singapur merkezli oyun geliştiricilerinin ABD pazarındaki toplam payı 6 yılda yüzde 1,2'den yüzde 18'e yükseldi. Küresel mobil oyun sektöründe rekabetin dengesi değişiyor. Çinli oyun geliştiricileri, 121 milyar dolarlık pazarda gelir paylarını yüzde 40'a çıkararak ABD'li rakiplerine büyük fark attı. Amerikan şirketlerinin payı gerilerken, Türkiye ve Singapur merkezli oyun şirketleri özellikle ABD pazarındaki hızlı büyümeleriyle öne çıktı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sensor Tower verilerine dayandırılan araştırma, mobil oyun sektöründe son iki yılda yaşanan değişimi ortaya koydu. 2024 yılının başında dünyanın en fazla gelir elde eden 100 mobil oyununda Çinli ve ABD'li yayıncılar birbirine yakın paylara sahipken, 2026'nın ortasında tablo Çin lehine değişti. Çinli şirketlerin küresel gelir payı yüzde 40'a ulaşırken, ABD merkezli yayıncıların payı yüzde 16,5'e kadar geriledi. Çinli şirketler ABD pazarında da güçleniyor Çinli oyun geliştiricilerinin yurt dışındaki en büyük pazarı ABD oldu. Ülkede en fazla gelir sağlayan 100 mobil oyun arasında Çinli yayıncıların payı, 2020'nin başındaki yüzde 8 seviyesinden 2025'te yüzde 18'in üzerine yükseldi. Aynı dönemde ABD'li şirketlerin kendi pazarlarındaki payı yüzde 40'tan yüzde 30'un altına düştü. Çinli geliştiricilerin yükselişinde Tencent'in Honor of Kings ve Whiteout Survival gibi dünya çapında geniş oyuncu kitlelerine ulaşan yapımlarının başarısı etkili oldu. Türkiye ve Singapur'un payı yüzde 18'e ulaştı Mobil oyun pazarındaki değişimin dikkat çeken diğer oyuncuları ise Türkiye ve Singapur oldu. Sensor Tower verilerine göre, iki ülkede faaliyet gösteren yayıncıların ABD'nin en yüksek gelir elde eden 100 mobil oyunundaki toplam payı, 2020'nin ilk çeyreğinde yalnızca yüzde 1,2 seviyesindeydi. Bu oran, 2026'nın ikinci çeyreğinde yüzde 18'e kadar yükseldi. Türkiye merkezli Dream Games'in geliştirdiği Royal Match ile Singapur merkezli Garena'nın Free Fire oyunu, söz konusu büyümede öne çıkan yapımlar arasında yer aldı. Sektörde artan birleşme ve satın alma faaliyetleri de Türkiye ve Singapur merkezli şirketlerin uluslararası pazarlardaki konumunu güçlendiren unsurlar arasında gösterildi. Mobil oyun pazarı 121 milyar dolara ulaştı Mobil oyun sektörü, yıllık 121 milyar dolarlık büyüklüğüyle eğlence ekonomisinin en önemli alanlarından biri haline geldi. Gelir açısından Hollywood ve müzik akışı sektörlerini geride bırakan mobil oyun pazarında, 2026 yılı boyunca dünya genelinde 3 milyardan fazla kişinin oyun oynaması bekleniyor. Çinli geliştiricilerin küresel pazardaki ağırlığı artarken, Türkiye ve Singapur gibi ülkelerin yükselişi de mobil oyun sektöründeki rekabetin giderek daha fazla ülkeye yayıldığını gösteriyor.
